items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: the trombone player was named Morris French.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's having to worry about it.

He come to my house about 6.30 that Sunday evening. Good catch. He said, remember old man Glennie? You know old man Glennie? Sure. Yeah, old man Glennie was with me because the old man Glennie played that same job. So I went on off, I played the job that night. And after I had played about four or five numbers, the trombone player was named Morris French. Morris French come over to me and says, to me he said, you're going to stay with the band?
